description: A generator of the THX deep note: four classes of voices spread across octaves, swelling from a spread of frequencies into a stereo chord, with panning, spectrum and amplitude animation

params.text: Sets the frequency of the first class of voices, which is spread over five octaves
Sets the frequency of the second class of voices, which is spread over six octaves
Sets the frequency of the third class of voices, which is spread low, middle and high
Sets the frequency of the fourth class of voices, which is spread low, middle and high

inputs.text: A voltage setting how long the sound takes to gather, the size of the voltage times 10 in seconds, from 0.001 to 999 seconds
A voltage setting that class's frequency, the size of the voltage times 10 in Hz, from 0.001Hz to 100Hz

outputs.text: The left side of the sound
The right side of the sound
A copy of the trigger that started the sound, for starting another module at the same moment

notes: TIME runs from 0.001 to 999 seconds and is set on its own display rather than with a knob
nothing is heard until the sound is started, by pressing the button or by a trigger; each start runs one gathering of the voices
this generator is costly to compute: the maker reports one of them taking about half the capacity of the machine he built it on, and recommends recording it on its own
